content:
maria: FYI — NovaCare procurement reached out asking for our compliance bundle for the POC: SOC2 Type II cover sheet, ISO excerpt, and a signed penetration-test attestation they can upload to their GRC portal. also asked whether they can schedule an unauthenticated external scan against a staging hostname. can we field this?
tony: I can draft the attestation. our standard is a short signed letter confirming scanning cadence, redaction rules, and that we can provide a redacted summary report. do they want the raw report or just the attestation?
maria: they said attestation preferred; redacted report optional. procurement also asked for a statement about data retention on staging during the POC.
sarah: operational constraints: unauth scans are allowed to a single hostname with a defined port list. we require 72 hours notice for firewall adjustments and an additional 24 hours to validate after the window. for auth scans we need an app-scoped test key and 48 hours to provision.
ton y: (typo) tony: quick pricing note — if they want us to spin up an isolated staging instance for their scan, that's charged as short-term reserved capacity. setup lead is ~5 business days. confirm whether they expect shared staging or dedicated.
sec-bot: Attestation template uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/templates/poc_pen_attestation_novacare.docx (SSO only)
sarah: upload rules: do NOT email reports. use presigned S3 links or the SSO-secure evidence drive. if customer cannot, file a support ticket for temporary SSO invitation. redaction guidance: strip PoCs, internal IPs, and session tokens; replace with a one-paragraph summary of findings.
maria: can we sign their vendor attestation form instead of ours? legal usually reviews customer forms and rarely agrees to extra liability language. if they send theirs, we'll route to legal and security for redlines.
ton y: I'll draft a provisional dedicated-staging estimate so procurement isn't blocked if they ask for isolation. posting estimate here once ready.
sarah: checklist I'll send them: 1) SOC2 Type II cover page (PDF) 2) ISO27001 excerpt (PDF) 3) signed pen-test attestation (PDF) 4) NDA if they request full report 5) allowed hosts + ports + time window 6) kill-switch contact + data retention statement (logs <=7 days).
maria: timeline: NovaCare wants everything by EOD Monday to close the vendor window. realistic?
sarah: possible if they accept shared staging and we get scope today. 72h for firewall + 24h validation -> 3 business days minimum, so Monday is tight unless scope confirmed immediately.
maria: OK — I'm asking them now for confirmation on shared vs dedicated and to send their vendor attestation if they prefer. tony -> please post attestation template and pricing estimate here. sarah -> prepare host/port example and the presigned upload flow.
ton y: putting names on it: tony -> attestation + estimate; sarah -> staging scheduling + upload flow; maria -> customer coordination. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: When complete, attach signed attestation PDF to ticket #POC-8812 and set evidence folder permission to 'shared-with-procurement'.
